g.title: note
g.text: One writer per state domain; one timer owner. Callbacks copy bounded data and notify the owner.
Validate generation, freshness, quality, correlation and buffer lifetime; stale callbacks cannot revive a session.
Protocol state / requests return through supervisor and facade (return edges omitted for clarity).
Permission gates readiness and energy progress; protocol authorization is evidence only.
Dashed amber = design extension, not enabled host session support.
